composition_label: Journey recommendations -> Adaptive onboarding -> Document review

construction.implementation_origin: Newly authored in the isolated build directory; no repository or other build files read or copied.

commands.working_directory: Run both commands from this build directory.

shared_schema.model: One JSON envelope is extended with validated stage fields; every stage preserves the original input.

profile.interests: Unique topic strings; an empty list permits deterministic discovery.
profile.preferred_formats: Nonempty ordered unique list drawn from text, video, exercise.
profile.completed_actions: Unique known action IDs whose prerequisites are also completed.

input_fields.actions: Objects with unique id, title, topic, prerequisites (known action IDs), requirement_ids (known requirement IDs). Cycles are rejected.
input_fields.requirements: Objects with unique id, description, required_terms (nonempty single-word strings, unique ignoring case).
input_fields.documents: Objects with unique id, locator, requirement_ids (known requirement IDs), nonempty text.

output_fields.status: ok indicates successful execution, not evidence sufficiency or certification.
output_fields.journey: state, ordered next_actions, exactly two prerequisite-safe steps when feasible, completion_policy.
output_fields.adaptive: state, steps referencing journey steps, review_requirement_ids.
output_fields.review: state, findings, gaps, explicit non-certification disclaimer.

shared_schema.validation: validate(envelope, through) checks exact envelope and input record keys, types, IDs, references, prerequisite graph, and completed-action consistency. Stage outputs are re-derived and compared before each handoff and after each stage, rejecting stale or modified data.
shared_schema.bounds: Each list has at most 100 entries. Typical strings are at most 200 characters; requirement descriptions 2000, document locators 1000, document texts 100000.
shared_schema.errors: Invalid JSON, duplicate JSON keys, non-finite constants, schema errors, decoding errors, recursion-limit errors and file errors produce one JSON object with status error and process exit 2. Success emits one JSON object and exit 0.

cross_stage_handoffs.consumes: Validated selected action IDs, journey step IDs, prerequisites and requirement IDs.
cross_stage_handoffs.invariant: Adaptive onboarding cannot substitute or bypass a selected journey action. Planning never completes an action; later steps with unfinished prerequisites remain conditional.

cross_stage_handoffs.consumes: Validated onboarding steps and deduplicated review_requirement_ids.
cross_stage_handoffs.invariant: Only requirements associated with selected onboarding steps are reviewed. Findings and gaps trace back to requirement, action, onboarding step, journey step, and any submitted evidence document and locator.

behavior.journey: Rank available next actions by topic-interest match then ID. Enumerate feasible distinct two-step paths, rank by total interest matches, prefer dependent sequential paths on ties, then use stable first/second action ranks.
behavior.adaptive: Use the first preferred format. Beginner instructions are guided with explanation/practice/confirmation; experienced instructions are concise with summary/confirmation. Explain both selections and prerequisite readiness.
behavior.review: Require all required terms to occur as case-insensitive whole words in at least one explicitly assigned document. Terms split across documents do not satisfy a requirement. Preserve all assigned-document observations; distinguish missing evidence from insufficient terms.
behavior.no_path: Return no_two_step_path, blocked_no_journey and not_applicable, without inventing steps. Available single next actions remain visible.
behavior.no_requirements: Return review state not_applicable, not a successful certification.
behavior.determinism: No randomness, clocks, external services, provider calls or LLM steps. No mutation of caller-owned input.
behavior.example: Select seller-profile then publish-listing; guide a beginner using exercise format. Seller identity evidence is found; returns policy has a traceable missing refund-term gap.

included: Shared validation and checked stage provenance
excluded: Live models, networks and provider calls
PDF parsing, OCR, file uploads or document retrieval
Semantic inference, negation detection and factual verification
Authenticity checking, compliance determination and certification
Executing actions or persisting real-world completion
Actual text, video or exercise content generation

coverage: Journey selection, interest personalization, prerequisites and stable tie-breaking
Beginner/experienced adaptation, preferred format and conditional readiness
Evidence matching, missing evidence, incomplete evidence and document locators
Case-insensitive whole-word matching and no cross-document term aggregation
No path, empty catalog, empty interests and no input mutation
Unknown references, cycles, inconsistent completion, duplicates and invalid schema
Tampered/stale handoffs, stage skipping and final-output validation
CLI success, missing files, usage, malformed JSON, duplicate keys, non-finite numbers and invalid encoding
